incidents.name: Webhook delivery delays
incidents.postmortem_summary: A burst of export.completed events produced a delivery queue backlog, delaying webhooks by up to 20 minutes. No events were lost and all deliveries caught up.

updates.body: We are investigating delayed webhook deliveries following a spike in event volume.
Identified a delivery queue backlog after a burst of export.completed events. Deliveries are delayed up to 20 minutes; no events have been lost.
The backlog has drained and webhook deliveries have caught up. Resolved.

incidents.name: Elevated login latency
incidents.postmortem_summary: A config change misconfigured the auth-provider cache, raising login latency to about 8s at p95. We rolled back the change and latency returned to normal.

updates.body: We are investigating reports of slow logins on the web app.
Identified an auth-provider cache misconfiguration introduced by a recent config change. Login p95 is around 8s. Rolling back.
The config change has been rolled back and login latency is back to normal. Resolved.

incidents.name: Ingestion lag and usage API errors
incidents.postmortem_summary: A routine deploy of our ingestion consumer introduced a performance regression under large batched payloads; we rolled it back. No customer data was lost.

updates.body: We are investigating ingestion delays and elevated errors on the usage API.
Identified an ingestion delay; dashboards may show stale data and /v1/usage is returning elevated 502s.
We have identified a recent deploy as the cause and are rolling it back.
The rollback is complete and we are monitoring recovery. Consumer lag is draining.
Consumer lag is at zero and error rates are back to normal. Queued events were backfilled with no data loss. Resolved.

incidents.name: Export rendering failures
incidents.postmortem_summary: A renderer dependency upgrade caused about 30% of PDF and CSV export jobs to fail. We pinned the previous version and re-ran the failed jobs.

updates.body: We are investigating failures in PDF and CSV export jobs.
Identified a renderer dependency upgrade causing roughly 30% of export jobs to fail. Pinning the previous version.
The previous renderer version has been pinned and failed export jobs have been re-run. Resolved.
